sources.title: DMTCP quick start
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: FTI 多層保護：鏡像與糾刪碼檢查點預算
related.titleEn: FTI multilevel protection: mirrored and erasure-coded checkpoint budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：重啟後結果與基準比對，未知支援的裝置明確列出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Post-restart results are compared with baseline and unsupported/unknown devices are explicit.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「FTI 多層保護：鏡像與糾刪碼檢查點預算」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付冗餘配置圖、128/80 GiB帳本與可／不可恢復失效集。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct FTI multilevel protection: mirrored and erasure-coded checkpoint budgets with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver redundancy maps, 128/80 GiB ledgers and recoverable/unrecoverable failure sets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 列四份2 GiB映像及共同checkpoint ID，計算共享寫入下界。
把64 GiB原始資料複製一次，兩副本放不同故障域。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: List four 2 GiB images with a common checkpoint ID and compute the shared-bandwidth bound.
Duplicate 64 GiB once and place copies in separate failure domains.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GEOPM Power Balancer：固定功率預算與慢節點
related.titleEn: GEOPM power balancing: fixed budgets and straggler nodes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：重啟後結果與基準比對，未知支援的裝置明確列出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Post-restart results are compared with baseline and unsupported/unknown devices are explicit.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「GEOPM Power Balancer：固定功率預算與慢節點」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付cap守恆、節點時間、能量上界與非功率瓶頸反例。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct GEOPM power balancing: fixed budgets and straggler nodes with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver cap conservation, node timings, energy bounds and non-power bottleneck counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 列四份2 GiB映像及共同checkpoint ID，計算共享寫入下界。
將800 W均分四份，使用最慢2秒算迭代能量上界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: List four 2 GiB images with a common checkpoint ID and compute the shared-bandwidth bound.
Split 800 W equally and use the slowest two-second duration for the energy bound.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
